The first thing I noticed upon entering the room was that it was hot and muggy with the heat of battle, also evidenced by corpses of Si branch Heishou torn wildly about the room.
多具黑兽 - 巳的尸身，以及四散延伸的血迹，让我感受到了这里之前发生激烈战斗的焦灼氛围。

dataList.content:
A bloodied beast rises ponderously from the ground, its gaze rising to meet ours.
某个浑身浴血呈现出野兽之形的人抬起头看向了我们。

Hold on, his eyes... something's definitely off here. He's not looking at us, he's—
等一下，他的视线……有点奇怪啊？这好像不是在看着我们……

Rodya cuts off abruptly, having noticed that something didn't feel right.
感到不妙的罗佳嘀咕道。

Away with you.
都给我退下。

The hooves intermittently kick the ground with anticipation and aggression.
马蹄踏向地面的声音……阵阵传来。

What happened here? Did the Heishou... make it into the exam hall?
你跟什么人交战了？难道是黑兽们……进入了那座考场？

Limbless snakes... dare trespass?
四肢全无的蛇崽子……你们当这是什么地方？

Your hideous coils...
你们那盘绕起来的丑恶之躯……

I will crush them to mulch under my hooves...
再怎么以马蹄蹂躏践踏也不为过……

You're... Wei, right...?
那是卫……没错吧？

He's completely lost it.
看来是彻底失去理智了。

I'll ground your filthy scales...
我要把你们尽数践踏……将肮脏的鳞片踏至一片不留……
